plain.li: [ail:Gout] Woke in the night with my big toe on fire. The blanket on it was too much to bear.
[ail:Gout,again] The gout's back, in the same toe. I know exactly which feast to blame.
[ail:Gout,trait:Gourmand] Gout. The price of eating well, they say. I'd still pay it, most days.
[ail:StoneDust] Came up from the rock face coughing gray. The dust gets into everything down there.
[ail:StoneDust,again] The stone dust is back in my chest. I'll take my turn somewhere with air next time.
[ail:SoreKnees] Spent the whole day on my knees. Now they've swollen up like bread dough.
[ail:SoreKnees,old] My knees aren't what they were. A day of kneeling and they've given up on me.
[ail:Ringworm] Found a red ring on my arm after milking. It itches like nothing else.
[ail:Ringworm,child] There's a red circle on my wrist. They say I got it from the animals.
[ail:Worms] I'm hungry an hour after every meal. Worms, from that raw meat, I'd bet.
[ail:Worms,again] Worms again. I should have waited for the cook.
[ail:SmokersCough,morning] Woke up coughing before the sun was up. Maybe I'll smoke less.
[ail:SmokersCough] The cough first thing in the morning has started to stay for an hour.
[ail:BeeStings] The bees caught me on the hand at the hives. It's twice its size tonight.
[ail:BeeStings,again] Stung again. The bees know I'm nervous, I'm sure of it.
[ail:Gout] I can put my boot on again. Greens with supper from now on, I promised.
[ail:StoneDust] The cough has gone, and the air tastes of nothing again.
[ail:SoreKnees] Knelt to tie my boot without thinking about it. The knees are fine.
[ail:Ringworm] The ring on my arm has faded to nothing. I wash after the animals now.
[ail:Worms] I'm hungry at the right times again. Cooked meat only, from now on.
[ail:SmokersCough] No cough this morning. I'll try to keep it that way.
[ail:BeeStings] The swelling's gone down. Back to the hives tomorrow, slowly.
[ail:Gout] Saw to {OTHER_nameDef}'s gout: the foot up, a cold cloth, and a word about the drink.
[ail:SoreKnees] Wrapped {OTHER_nameDef}'s knees and told them to keep off them for a few days.
[ail:Ringworm] Put salve on the ring on {OTHER_nameDef}'s arm and sent the bedding to be washed.
[ail:Worms] Gave {OTHER_nameDef} a dose for the worms. Cooked meat only, I told them.
[ail:Gout] Don't come near my foot, the gout has it.
[ail:Gout] Greens with supper for me, the doctor's orders.
[ail:StoneDust] Sorry, that's the stone dust talking, not me.
[ail:StoneDust] I still taste rock every time I cough.
[ail:SoreKnees] Someone else can scrub that floor, my knees are done.
[ail:SoreKnees] Help me up, would you, my knees have gone stiff.
[ail:Ringworm] Don't touch my arm, it's only ringworm, but still.
[ail:Worms] Is there any more bread, I'm starving again.
[ail:Worms] I just ate and I'm hungry already.
[ail:SmokersCough,morning] Give me a minute, it's the morning cough.
[ail:SmokersCough] Excuse me, this cough won't let go of me.
[ail:BeeStings] The bees won today, look at my hand.
